name: Re:amaze
description: Re:amaze is a customer-service platform for shared inboxes, email, chat, social messaging, SMS, voice, customer conversations, automation, FAQs, and ecommerce support.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Re:amaze brand, dedicated user login email, and individual API token, then let selected agents use content-free conversation operations or approved documented API v1 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: REAMAZE_BRAND
credentialRequirements.label: Re:amaze brand
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the brand hostname label before .reamaze.io.

credentialRequirements.name: REAMAZE_LOGIN_EMAIL
credentialRequirements.label: Re:amaze login email
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the email of a dedicated least-privilege Re:amaze user.

credentialRequirements.name: REAMAZE_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Re:amaze API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate the dedicated user's individual API token in Re:amaze settings.

capabilities.label: Read conversation operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded conversation operational metadata without subjects, message bodies, authors, emails, assignees, followers, tags, channel names/addresses, custom data, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Re:amaze API v1
capabilities.description: Use documented brand-bound API v1 paths and methods allowed by the connected user's API token.

approvalRequired.label: List conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free Re:amaze conversation summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Re:amaze conversation through Relay's content-free projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use Re:amaze API v1
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Re:amaze API v1 operation authorized by the user's API token; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free conversation reads and every broader API operation require approval; brand/version binding, Basic-auth secret isolation, user context, bounds, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected user-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; brand/version binding, Basic-auth secret isolation, bounds, audits, and Re:amaze limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted login email/API token only to the brand-bound Re:amaze API v1 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted login email/API token only to the brand-bound Re:amaze API v1 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Re:amaze brand plus dedicated user's login email and individual API token are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated least-privilege Re:amaze user and individual API token, enter the brand/email/token in Relay, and verify bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader operations, rate limits, token regeneration, user removal, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Re:amaze's official API introduction defines brand-scoped reamaze.io HTTPS origins, per-user API tokens, HTTP Basic authentication using login email plus token, JSON API v1 resources, and HTTP 429 rate limiting.
Re:amaze's official conversation reference defines the /api/v1/conversations list endpoint, page metadata, filters, status codes, channel codes, unique conversation slugs, and response shape.
Re:amaze documents exact conversation retrieval by slug at /api/v1/conversations/{slug}.
